{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
test_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Exclude test orders from the total
total_revenue = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]['revenue_numeric'].sum()

print(f"Number of completed test orders (revenue == 999999.99): {test_orders.shape[0]}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
